text: {"frames":["The mill on the fourth floor of the Tower began to turn its sails on a still morning, with not a breath of wind over the polders. Gareth, the mapmaker, dropped his pencil into the canal below and watched the gears grind awake. On his drawing board he had sketched a canal that did not exist, and now the water was pouring out of the mill wheel into it. The mill needs the sign that stands between 14 and 16, with the 14 written first, before the sluice gate will close. What sign goes between 14 and 16?","Marijke had lined up her jars of fog on the windowsill of the Tower's second floor, and a boat drifted in through the mist with a locked casket aboard. The casket was rattling and humming, and somebody had written two numbers on the lid in chalk. Marijke set her jars down one by one, fourteen of them on the left and sixteen on the right, and the fog began to seep out through the cracks. The casket will only open when the right sign is chalked between 14 and 16, the 14 first. What sign goes between 14 and 16?","Every window of the crooked house with the hoist beam glowed gold, though nobody lived there, and a smell of warm waffles rolled down the lane. Fenna, the bell-ringer of the drowned village, stood at the foot of the ladder and counted the candles in the windows with her lips moving. She had heard the bell ring from under the water when no one pulled the rope, and now it was swinging again. The hoist beam creaks open the door only when the candles are compared, 14 candles against 16, the 14 counted first. What sign goes between 14 and 16?","Joop the stork stood on one leg at the top of the Tower and clacked his beak at the new shadow that had crept across the wall overnight. The shadow was taller than yesterday and it was wearing a cheese maker's apron, and it was walking toward the market steps. Joop wanted to chase it before the herring sellers arrived, so he ran along the gutter with his wings half open. He had to decide which pen to take to the shadow, the one marked 14 or the one marked 16, and the sign between them tells which pen is the right one. What sign goes between 14 and 16?","The old map showed a canal nobody remembered, curling through the Tower like a loose thread, and the mapmaker's apprentice had been staring at it since breakfast. She wanted that canal more than she had ever wanted anything, because a lock at its end held the winter ice of the whole town. A tulip-field boy named Teun offered to trade her a wooden clog for the map, but she only shook her head and tapped the margin. There were two numbers scribbled there, 14 and 16, and the sign between them shows whether the lock opens toward the canal or away from it. What sign goes between 14 and 16?"]}
